note: Abel's golden set (1.9): made-up sentences a student might type, never real ones. A sentence passes when the results include any of its expected feelings. Neutral sentences should find no feeling at all. Add the phrasings students really use.

sentences.text: I don't see the point of anything lately
everyone's moving on without me
my heart won't slow down before the test
I can't stop thinking about what could go wrong
there's just too much on my plate right now
I have three deadlines tomorrow and I haven't started
nobody here really knows me
I eat lunch alone every day
I miss home so much
my grandmother passed away last week
I keep crying and I don't know why
everything feels grey
I feel nothing at all, just empty
I'm so done with my flatmate, he never listens
I want to scream at my parents
whatever I do it's never enough
everyone in my class is smarter than me
I'm scared to walk home at night
I'm terrified of failing this year
I don't feel God anymore when I pray
I'm not sure I still believe
church feels empty for me now
I did something I'm really ashamed of
I lied to my best friend and feel awful
today was actually a really good day
I'm thankful for my friends
I finally feel hopeful about next term
I can't sleep because my mind keeps racing
I'm exhausted all the time and running on empty
my parents expect too much from me

neutral: I have a meeting with my tutor tomorrow
I need to buy a new phone charger
what time does the library open
I'm going to the gym later
